Customer Management Centre
A New Chapter Begins:
Welcome to Our New Customer Management Centre!
Dear Valued Client,
We’re excited to share great news: our brand-new Customer Management Centre is now open at Al Maryah Tower, Al Maryah Island!
This new space has been set up to better serve you, with the aim of making your experience with Modon Real Estate more accessible and efficient.
Our team will be pleased to assist you with any of the following post-sales services:
Real Estate Services Signature Services Property Transfer
Milestone Collection Property Handover
Our dedicated team is ready to assist you every step of the way. Whether you have a question or wish to schedule an appointment, simply call us at 800 MODON or email customercare@modon.ae.
You can also connect with us in the way most convenient for you:
Voice Facebook Instagram Whatsapp
Location: 20ᵗʰ floor, Al Maryah Tower, Maryah Island. For directions, please click [here].
Working Hours: Monday to Friday | 8:00am – 5:00pm
Parking: Customer parking is available at The Galleria Mall. The closest parking zone to our location is Zone A. Please take the skywalk bridge located at Centrepoint store directly to Al Maryah Tower.
We look forward to welcoming you to our new centre and continuing to serve you with excellence. Thank you for being a valued member of the Modon Real Estate community.
Warm regards, Modon Customer Management Team.
